rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for an explosive substance.

example.english: The police found a large amount of explosive at the scene.
example.traditional: 警方喺現場發現大量炸藥。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 hai2 jin6 coeng4 faat3 jin6 daai6 loeng6 zaa3 joek6

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose description for a device or substance that can or is likely to explode.

example.english: This kind of battery is explosive, so don't leave it somewhere hot.
example.traditional: 呢種電池好容易爆炸，唔好放喺高溫地方。
example.jyutping: nei1 zung2 din6 ci4 hou2 jung4 ji6 baau3 zaa3 m4 hou2 fong3 hai2 gou1 wan1 dei6 fong1

rows.note: Use this for a person, personality, or temper that flares up into anger easily.

example.english: He's explosive and starts yelling whenever things don't go his way.
example.traditional: 佢個人好火爆，一有少少唔順意就鬧人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 fo2 baau3 jat1 jau5 siu2 siu2 m4 seon6 ji3 zau6 naau6 jan4

rows.note: Use this for an accusation or other statement that is shocking or startling rather than physically dangerous.

example.english: The inside story of this scandal is truly explosive.
example.traditional: 呢單醜聞嘅內幕真係好驚人。
example.jyutping: ni1 daan1 cau2 man4 ge3 noi6 mok6 zan1 hai6 hou2 ging1 jan4
